# Rothenburg Tour

> An independent visitor guide to Rothenburg ob der Tauber, Bavaria — the walled medieval town on Germany's Romantic Road. Published by the team behind the TouringBee self-guided audio tours. Facts, prices and opening hours are checked against official sources (Rothenburg Tourismus Service, the museums, the Night Watchman) and dated.

## Key facts
- Rothenburg ob der Tauber is a walled town of about 11,400 people in Middle Franconia, Bavaria, on the Romantic Road.
- Free imperial city from 1274. The Meistertrunk (1631) is a legend first recorded over a century after the events.
- On 31 March 1945 bombing destroyed around 275 houses, six public buildings, nine watchtowers and roughly 600 m of the town wall; John J. McCloy prevented artillery bombardment. Rebuilt stretches of wall carry donor names.
- The old town and the covered rampart walk on the town wall are free and open at any hour.
- Town Hall Tower: EUR 4 adults, cash only. Medieval Crime Museum: daily 10:00-18:00, EUR 10.50 adults.
- Night Watchman tour: English 20:00, German 21:30, ~1 hour, EUR 8 adults, meets on Marktplatz.
- Reiterlesmarkt Christmas market 2026: 20 November - 23 December 2026.
- There is no mainline railway station; arrive via Steinach bei Rothenburg on a local shuttle train, or by car.
